name: Glassmorphism
blurb: Nocturne glassmorphism: colourless white glass at 5-12% over a deep ink night scene lit by soft radial light wells, with heavy backdrop blur, a saturation boost, directional inset edges and one champagne accent. The scene owns the colour; the glass only borrows its light.

tagline.en: Colourless glass over a deep night scene
tagline.zh: 深夜场景之上，一层不着色的玻璃

origin.note: Vetta-adapted from the StyleKit Glassmorphism guide and its showcase page: rewritten as Vetta spec prose and re-expressed in Vetta base tokens. Glass alphas, blur, light-well and shadow values follow the showcase's own CSS. No upstream assets included.
